title: Function pipeline
prompt: Implement `static int Pipe(int input, params Func<int, int>[] steps)` — apply each function in order to the result of the previous. Empty/null steps → input unchanged.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Same functions, different order, different answer — sequential application.

tests.name: edges
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.Pipe(7, x => x), 7, "identity");
Cj.Eq(Solution.Pipe(7, null), 7, "null steps treated as none");
tests.hint: Null-safe: an absent pipeline is the identity function.
